answer: Path-diversity weighting scores each identity by the number of disjoint routes its traffic traverses, discounting clusters sharing a common relay. A new identity starts with a low-weight relic of its onboarding path, so cheap mass registration yields negligible routing weight. Because each Sybil must replicate distinct relay neighborhoods to gain influence, the attacker pays bandwidth and latency for redundant infrastructure proportional to the target weight. Honest peers accumulate a stable ember of trust through repeated diverse routing, while a raven forged at scale stays cold.
